entryCirculation.method: swept circle radius600mm every25mm and72 directions; union of current ground-floor polygons minus holes and architectural body blockers; proposed exterior furniture envelopes
entryCirculation.note: 1200mm is one continuous southwest main approach, not a claim that every gap between coffee tables is a circulation aisle. The535mm chair-side gaps are ordinary local seat access only.
entryCirculation.adjacentSpaceCaveat: Current room-scene.json is empty architectural space. Adjoining designed screen/planter and all furniture must remain outside this same reserved main route.

uncertainties: The CAD inner-radius geometry is reliable as original drawing geometry, but not a fresh site survey; the original DXF predates later wall/window updates.
The2890mm low ceiling,850/2500mm window levels, local beam/column sizes and track/HVAC offsets are provisional model visual fits.

P01 enlarged true-curve upholstery is a custom design. Confirm outer/inner radii, four thick cushions, continuous rounded arms, seams, transportation joints, window operation and actual finished-wall clearance with maker/site.
O06/O60/O47/W23 dimensions are proposed planning envelopes. Only O11 nominal dimensions have a retained manufacturer source record; client product dimensions still require confirmation.
Displayed minimum distances are rounded calculations between conservative2D planning envelopes. They are not verified real manufactured contours or construction tolerances.
A larger sofa and three chairs are feasible in the current architectural floor footprint, but neighbouring furnished-space conflicts are not encoded in the empty room model.

reachAndCapacity.zoneBoundaryNote: Current software round-living zone closes atZ=-11.9 as a navigation region, not a physical wall. South chair rear extends385mm beyond that region line but remains inside the nominal6m full circle and actual continuous ground-floor polygon.
reachAndCapacity.note: The535mm gaps between south and side chairs are local access only. The southwest main route remains1200mm. Four sofa users use O06 (front-centre edge distance about559–593mm); each O11 receives a nearby smaller table.

designTradeoffs: A150-degree5.14m-wide P01 cannot also have a generous circulation aisle behind it in a6m circle. Keep the1200mm main route to the southwest; the308mm rear allowance is maintenance only.

Three full-size O11 chairs cannot all remain within comfortable reach of the single central O06 while preserving the large sofa and entry. Keep O06 for the four sofa seats and add the three confirmed black/white small tables for the chairs and arc ends.
Do not call the300mm space between O06 and the two O60 tables a walkway. It is spacing within the coffee-table cluster.
The third chair was moved100mm north from an earlier trial: its rear rectangle corners now remain about114mm inside the nominal full circle, and local gaps to the side chairs stay about535mm.
All added wall relief/mirror remains wall-mounted. Current room-scene is architecture only; verify that the previously designed neighbouring screen/planter does not occupy the reserved route.

The south chair uses continuous open ground within the nominal full circle. The software round-living closing line is not a wall; known red screen/dining furniture atX≤9 is well separated. The actual rear-to-C2 edge gap is about1301mm and supports a1100mm auxiliary passage. Final field total-plan verification remains required.
